title: Subspace gradient descent method for linear tensor equations
summary: The numerical solution of algebraic tensor equations is a largely open and challenging task. Assuming that the operator is symmetric and positive definite, we propose two new gradient-descent type methods for tensor equations that generalize the recently proposed Subspace Conjugate Gradient (SS-CG), D. Palitta et al, SIAM J. Matrix Analysis and Appl (2025). As our interest is mainly in a modest number of tensor modes, the Tucker format is used to efficiently represent low-rank tensors.
